eligibility_note: Own IV-GMM estimation on 123 economies (45 HIC, 58 MIC, 20 LIC) with explicit income-group comparison; exposure is mobile, internet, fixed broadband and a PCA ICT index; outcomes are GDP per capita and labour productivity (family 1).

results.quote: lnict 0.094*** (0.032)  [Table 8, col 4, HIC; robust SE in parentheses]

heterogeneity.quote: The findings prove that MIC gains more than LIC and HIC from the ICT revolution. [Section 4, p. 8]; internet/fbb largest in HIC, mobile largest in MIC (Table 8)

income_group_note: HIC 0.094/0.065, MIC 0.422/0.374, LIC 0.158/0.218 match Tables 8 and 9; upper and lower middle are pooled in MIC (Table A1 lists a single MIC group).

risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: causal wording and IV with lags of investment (also a control) as instruments, only two controls, no fixed effects, ICT-lag instruments dropped after Hansen rejections.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: group-specific PCA index of three logged access indicators, not comparable across income groups.
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: broad WDI sample of 123 economies, unbalanced (Table 8 obs 224-812), MIC pooled.
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: agree: GDP per capita level is labelled 'economic growth'; labour productivity from Conference Board has fewer observations.
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: instrument set changed after over-identification rejections and no sensitivity checks (arguably borderline between serious and moderate).
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: only ICT coefficients shown 'for brevity', ICT-lag results in supplementary material, no test of group differences.
risk_of_bias.why: Standard cross-country IV-GMM with weak, questionable instruments and causal claims, so serious is appropriate.

problems: none material; record agrees with the text. Minor: Table 3 gives 720/928/320 obs for lngdp while Table 8 uses 630/812/280 or fewer (record notes this); n_specifications 24 correct; Hansen p-values 0.077 (col 3) and 0.062 (col 9) correct.
